name: Unverified_b5cb
fix_description: The fallback function (label_0070/func_0190) processes arbitrary selectors without access control. Add msg.sender validation in the fallback path, similar to the owner check in func_00BC (require msg.sender == owner or isAuthorized).
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: flash loan BUSD, swap into UN, abuse the pair via repeated token transfers plus skim calls to manipulate balances/reserves, then swap back for profit and repay. It requires understanding UniswapV2 pair accounting and the skim-based balance mismatch issue, so it is not purely trivial even though the PoC is compact.
